profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I enjoy writing quality, performance-sensitive code used by hundreds of millions of people around the globe and tackling challenging systems problems.  Recent experience includes computer and datacenter networking, device drivers, network virtualization and containerization, and operating systems.  Skilled in C with some experience in C++, C#/Java, and Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the Windows networking stack.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Developed and shipped a user mode SDK, Windows 10 drivers, and the company website while working on the next gen of timing synchronization boards.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Maintained the Windows IP stack and worked on Hyper-V Network Virtualization and other datacenter-related technologies.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Fellow
positions.description: Head TF for CS 61 and TF for CS 51 and CS S182.  Taught section and held office hours.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on five-tuple filtering of IPsec encapsulated packets using the Windows Filtering Platform in the vSwitch layer.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed scripts for analyzing data for an optimization mode for Synopsys's HDL simulator, VCS, in the Verification Group.
